blocking_finding.requirement: the R067 retry packet has exactly ten service owners; any missing, extra, or terminal-reported mismatch must block and leave recovery to root
blocking_finding.source_behavior: the watcher only asserts len(owners) == t['actual_services'] and owners; it does not assert the expected count of 10

blocking_finding.required_resolution: add an immutable-source guard requiring t['actual_services'] == 10 and len(owners) == 10 before cleanup sealing or D09 launch; do not auto-unlock or recover leftovers
